synthesis.content:
### Central insight
Use the article’s hypothetical call to follow bending sound paths through layers of different temperature and pressure.

### Evidence
In the example sound slows and refracts downward as temperature drops. Near the bottom of the thermocline sound speed reaches a minimum; deeper, temperature remains stable and increasing pressure raises speed, bending the sound upward. Hydrophones at a suitable depth can detect distant signals.

### Gaps and uncertainty
Keep the whale example illustrative and avoid making a universal distance claim.
